pack.name: Wear OS Micro Icons — Free Starter
pack.description: A free 24-icon starter set from the Wear OS Micro Icons pack: complication-safe pixel icons for watch faces and tiny wrist UI.
pack.license: Free Sampler License (commercial use of the sampler files; no redistribution as an icon pack). See LICENSE.md.

icons.name: Heart
icons.recommendedUse: Use as a health, love, favorite, or like marker in Wear OS health and body screens.
icons.notes: Symmetric solid heart: two 2px lobe tops over a 1px center dip, sides curve down via a single-step orthogonal staircase to one bottom point.

icons.name: Heart Pulse
icons.recommendedUse: Use for heart-rate, cardio, or vital-signs readouts in a health and body tracking context.
icons.notes: Solid two-lobe heart with a 1px ECG trace (flat-peak-trough-flat) carved through rows 8-10 as fully enclosed negative space.

icons.name: Steps
icons.recommendedUse: Use for a step counter, walking activity, or pedometer/fitness tracking tile.
icons.notes: Two solid oval soles offset diagonally, each with a one-row negative-space gap splitting ball from heel; every ink pixel keeps an orthogonal neighbour.

icons.name: Run
icons.recommendedUse: Use for a running/sprint state in a steps or activity tracker, a workout-mode toggle, or a "move/exercise" prompt on a Wear OS watch face.
icons.notes: Round head over a forward-leaning torso with bent front/back arms and a wide split stride, all built as 2px orthogonal staircases so every ink pixel shares an edge.

icons.name: Battery Half
icons.recommendedUse: Battery level complication at roughly half charge.
icons.notes: Half-width fill in the shared battery shell.

icons.name: Battery Charging
icons.recommendedUse: Charging-state complication; lightning bolt inside the battery shell.
icons.notes: Edge-connected lightning bolt inside the shell.

icons.name: Sun
icons.recommendedUse: Clear / sunny weather condition; daytime; high temperature.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Moon
icons.recommendedUse: Clear night condition; nighttime indicator.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Cloud
icons.recommendedUse: Cloudy / overcast condition. Base cloud shape for the weather family.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Rain
icons.recommendedUse: Rain / showers.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Clock
icons.recommendedUse: Time display / analog clock.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Calendar
icons.recommendedUse: Calendar / date.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Alarm
icons.recommendedUse: Alarm set / wake time.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Map
icons.recommendedUse: Use for map, directions, location overview, or trip-planning entry points in a navigation menu.
icons.notes: One connected folded paper map: three panels with a zig-zag (accordion) top and bottom edge and two enclosed 1px negative-space fold creases, kept a single silhouette so it never splits into separate bars.

icons.name: Location
icons.recommendedUse: Use to mark a place, destination, or current location on maps and navigation screens.
icons.notes: A solid teardrop built as orthogonal staircases: a round head with a fully-enclosed circular eye carved as negative space, tapering to a single edge-connected point at bottom-center.

icons.name: Phone
icons.recommendedUse: Make or receive a call; phone/dialer launcher; call complication.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Message
icons.recommendedUse: Single message or SMS; messaging launcher; new-text complication.
icons.notes: Single-ink silhouette; details are negative space. Complication-safe; tints uniformly.

icons.name: Play
icons.recommendedUse: Start or resume media playback; play button for music, video, and podcast complications or watch-face transport controls.
icons.notes: Single-ink right-pointing triangle.

icons.name: Pause
icons.recommendedUse: Pause active media playback; pairs with play in transport controls.
icons.notes: Two vertical bars.

icons.name: Check
icons.recommendedUse: Success, completed, confirmed, selected, or okay states in compact Wear OS status surfaces.
icons.notes: Bare bold check mark; kept free of a circle so it does not collide with info or do-not-disturb.

icons.name: Warning
icons.recommendedUse: Warning, caution, attention, risk, or system alert states in tiny Wear OS status areas.
icons.notes: Triangle warning emblem with a bold internal exclamation mark.

icons.name: Wifi
icons.recommendedUse: Wi-Fi, wireless network, connected, online, or local network status in compact Wear OS surfaces.
icons.notes: Three stacked wireless arcs plus a center dot; separated from signal by arc silhouette.

icons.name: Watch Face
icons.recommendedUse: Watch face picker, face template, wearable UI surface, or general watch-face customization entry points.
icons.notes: Round face with top and bottom strap blocks; distinct from clock by using a watch-body silhouette.

icons.name: Fish
icons.recommendedUse: Pet/companion, aquatic, fishing, aquarium, or pond/koi motifs; cozy watch-face decoration; on-brand Pixelpond accent.
icons.notes: Single-ink right-facing koi; eye is negative space.
